body.statement:
For every \(P\in\mathcal F_s\) and smooth four-density path with tangent \(\delta\), the selected lifted map \(P\mapsto(\widetilde T(\widetilde y_j))_{j=1}^J\) is Frechet differentiable and its derivative is exactly \(\mathcal D_P[\delta]=\mathcal H_P[\delta]+ ig(
abla\mathcal L_B^{-1}\Pi_0[\alpha(e_{C1}-e_{C0})+e_{T0}-e_{T1}]-
abla\mathcal L_B^{-1}\Pi_0[(\mathsf C
abla\alpha)\cdot
abla\mathcal L_{\mathsf C}^{-1}(e_{C1}-e_{C0})] ig)_{\mathcal Y_J}\), where \(\mathcal H_P[\delta]=(\dot a_T-
abla\mathcal L_B^{-1}\Pi_0[(\mathsf C
abla\alpha)\cdot\dot a_p])_{\mathcal Y_J}\), \(\dot a_p=\partial_t a_{p_t}|_{t=0}\), and \(\dot a_T=\partial_t a_{T_t}|_{t=0}\). The coefficient multiplying the pulled-back inner equation satisfies \(B D^{-\mathsf T}=\alpha\mathsf C\). The map \(\delta\mapsto(\dot a_p,\dot a_T)\) has cellwise Riesz scores with uniformly bounded \(L^2(P_g)\) norms. Consequently \(\mathcal H_P\) contributes \(O(1/\log(1/h))\) to \(\Sigma_h(P)\), and its cross-covariance with the Green score is \(O(1/\sqrt{\log(1/h)})\), both uniformly over \(\mathcal F_s\). This strictly extends the one-target density-curve derivative in GonzalezSanzSheng2024Linearization to a four-input nested map with a generated target law and nonzero harmonic translation modes.
body.justification: The identity exposes every generated-target path, separates the bounded harmonic translation mode, and reduces the singular part to one outer elliptic inverse.
body.gap: GonzalezSanzSheng2024Linearization differentiates one target-density curve with a fixed source; it does not differentiate an outer map whose target is itself an estimated pushforward through an inner map.
body.consumer: The exact weights determine which of the four Card--Krueger cells drives uncertainty in each bivariate counterfactual arrow.
